In the European Youth Olympic Festival, we were represented by Wade Bennett-Jackson, who took gold in both the 100 m and 200 m, Amala Onuora and Chris Gearing.
Sixteen year old Wade Bennett-Jackson won his debut B 100m while under-23 Tim Abeyie won the A 200m in a time only 1/100th slower than Graham's.

James Ellington's 10.7 in the 100m was half a second and 5 metres ahead of the second placer, and Wade Bennett-Jackson did even better in the B race with his 10.6, nearly 10 metres clear at the finish line.

It's been a remarkable season for Wade Bennett-Jackson (pictured above) who only turned 16 last February. He set some outstanding personal records early in the season and competed with distinction in the AAA Under 20 Championships.
